detection_note: Alipay opendocs is a client-side rendered SPA: two different doc URLs return byte-identical HTML shells, so deterministic L0/L1 fingerprinting cannot observe content. Automated drift detection is disabled for this platform; freshness relies on the runtime gate (agents check current official docs at platform-touching steps) and voluntary user reports. L2 via a JS-capable engine may be added later.
